title: When the 547/727 prime race first misses an 18H deadline
description:
Through exp(40.0507)/(2 sqrt(2)), the sharp simultaneous completion factor for the 547/727 dyadic race stays 17.493385009687... . Through exp(41.33)/(2 sqrt(2)), both moves finish before 19.95H. Both bounds use established finite zero computations. The first 18H miss on the larger interval is a loss, subject to a further critical-line check on eight primitive Dirichlet factors through ordinate five million.

Proof and hypotheses.
